children: US luxury apparel retailer's Q2 net sales grew 11.7% yr/yr, driven by both segments
Adjusted EPS for Q2 rose sharply yr/yr
Company completed OVO acquisition, entering streetwear market
Vince Holding raises full-year fiscal 2026 guidance for the Vince Business
Company expects Q3 Vince Business net sales to rise 5%-8% year over year
Vince Holding sees full-year Vince Business net sales up 8%-10% from prior year
SEGMENT GROWTH - Sales rose in both direct-to-consumer (up 13.7%) and wholesale (up 10.4%) segments
TARIFF REFUND - Gross profit and adjusted earnings benefited from a $10.4 mln IEEPA tariff refund
HIGHER COSTS - Product and freight costs increased, negatively impacting gross margin excluding tariff refund
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the apparel & accessories retailers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Vince Holding Corp is $9.00, about 41.1% above its September 9 closing price of $6.38
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
